prompt: 未払利息の決算整理仕訳を行え。

given.map_note: InterestPayable (未払利息) has no dedicated EA constructor. EA models generic accrued liabilities via 'AccruedExpenses' (未払費用, 経過勘定) rather than itemized accrued-interest accounts, so InterestPayable is mapped provisionally to AccruedExpenses. Accounting-review point: does collapsing accrued interest into the generic accrued-expense line lose information an auditor would want to keep separately identifiable (e.g. for interest-coverage analysis)?
